description: This file contains methods related to managing file accessibility within the Mattermost application, including filtering files based on cloud plan limits, marking files as inaccessible, and handling inaccessible file lists.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main application struct with methods to handle file accessibility filtering.

classes.name: FileInfo
classes.description: Represents file metadata, including creation time and ID.

classes.name: FileInfoList
classes.description: Contains a list of FileInfo objects and their order, along with the first inaccessible file time.

methods.name: removeInaccessibleContentFromFilesSlice
methods.description: Removes content from files beyond the cloud plan's limit and returns the first inaccessible file time.

methods.name: filterInaccessibleFiles
methods.description: Filters out files past the cloud limit, modifying the FileInfoList in place.

methods.name: isInaccessibleFile
methods.description: Checks if a specific file is past the cloud plan's limit.

methods.name: getFilteredAccessibleFiles
methods.description: Returns accessible files filtered according to cloud plan limits, along with the first inaccessible file time.
